listen_port.description: UDP port on which the sFlow collector listens for incoming packets.

bind_address.description: IP address to bind the collector to. Leave empty to listen on all interfaces.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable support for IPv6 sFlow/NetFlow packets.

input_format.description: Protocol format to parse: 'sflow', 'netflow', 'ipfix', or 'auto' (detect automatically).

output_dir.description: Directory where flow files (e.g., nfcapd.YYYYMMDDHHmm) will be written. Must exist and be writable by the daemon user.

rotate_interval.description: Time interval (in seconds) after which flow files are rotated.

retention_period.description: Number of seconds to retain flow files. Set to 0 to keep indefinitely.

daemon_user.description: System user account under which the collector daemon runs (for security).

daemon_group.description: System group for the daemon user (optional — leave empty to omit).

verbose_logging.description: Enable detailed logging to syslog for troubleshooting.

max_file_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per flow file before rotation. Overrides rotate_interval if set >0.

compress_flows.description: Compress rotated flow files with gzip to save disk space.

stream_target.description: Target host:port to forward live flows (e.g., '192.168.1.10:9995'). Leave empty to disable streaming.

extended_nf9.description: Parse extended NetFlow v9 and IPFIX options (e.g., BGP next-hop, MPLS) — recommended for modern networks.

allow_sources.description: List of source IP subnets (CIDR notation) allowed to send sFlow/NetFlow data. Empty = accept from any source.

items.description: IPv4/IPv6 CIDR subnet allowed as sender (e.g., '10.0.0.0/8')

no_flow_aggregation.description: Disable flow aggregation (one file per flow record instead of time-binned); mainly for debugging.
